bullets.bullet_text: Implemented SOC 2-aligned AWS controls enabling regulated insurers to safely adopt analytics and ML capabilities within governed cloud environments.
Re-architected insurer underwriting and operational systems to deliver high-availability, real-time processing across core business functions.
Established a shared-responsibility operating model clarifying AWS versus insurer-owned control ownership, strengthening regulated cloud governance.
